_comment: Who may be drawn, and when: player id → the day his window opened (days since puzzle #1, 2026-11-11), or window edges [from, until, from, …] for a player who lost a photo for a while. A player is drawn only while he has BOTH a real headshot and a real playing photo. Written by `npm run build-players`, which never changes an edge already written and dates new ones the day after the build. NEVER edit or delete this file: it is the history of every lineup, and a changed past edge re-rolls days already played. See docs/DATA.md §Photos.
